name: Seamless Manufacturing
old_description: For more than 15 years, we have been serving our customers in Riverside, CA and the entire USA with premium printing services that include embroidery, screen printing, Direct To Garment (DTG) and more! Whether you need a large batch of t-shirts for your business or another collection for your clothing line, we have got you covered.
about:
Seamless Manufacturing operates from Riverside, California, where it has provided custom apparel decoration services for over 15 years. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The shop specializes in embroidery, screen printing, and direct-to-garment (DTG) printing, supplemented by folding and poly‑bagging services. It offers pre‑priced package deals such as 50‑piece runs of oversized tees, baseball caps, and embroidered caps, though facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not specified.

Seamless serves businesses and clothing lines across the United States that need branded or custom garments. The company does not list specific industry verticals, but its package offerings target promotional‑product distributors, corporate apparel programs, and independent apparel brands.

The company emphasizes attention to detail at every production step, highlighting its folding and poly‑bagging as a differentiator. Customer feedback notes quick turnaround times, and the firm states it aims to exceed expectations on each order.
